description: DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.Tool is the canvasnet command-line tool: it inspects, renders, and transforms images and documents (PNG, JPEG, BMP, TIFF, GIF, JPEG 2000, SVG, PDF, PowerPoint, Visio, OpenSCAD models, Vega-Lite charts, and Mermaid diagrams) using the CanvasNet libraries, with a stable machine-readable JSON contract so that scripts and AI agents can drive it.
title: CanvasNet Tool
